parsed.use_case: A configuration service may need to enumerate every valid combination of optional features for a small set of independent flags, such as generating test cases for feature interactions. The same task appears when listing every possible selection of items from a small catalog.
system_examples: Property-based testing frameworks — generate combinations of optional inputs or settings to exercise a function across cases.
Feature-flag configuration tools — enumerate combinations of a small set of independent flags for validation or testing.
parsed.explanation: Backtracking builds each subset by deciding whether to include each element, taking O(n·2^n) time to produce the output and O(n) auxiliary space, versus checking all 2^n candidates with extra work to construct each one. Since the output itself has 2^n subsets, exponential time is unavoidable; in production this is practical only for small inputs.
